groups.why_chosen: Two stacked circuit variants share one input row and one four-colour weight-value key, so shrinking 16 multipliers to 4 shared accumulators is visible as a colour count, not a claim.
groups.what_to_learn: Stack both variants on one aligned input row, colour every occurrence of the same weight value identically in both, so sixteen boxes shrinking to four reads as a colour count — but the routing order still needs tracing.
